title: Deployment readiness quickscore - crossflow impact log (Aug 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight cross-functional scoring sheet to quickly assess readiness and customer-impact risk for the Aug 2026 rolling deploy. Use for 15-minute triage calls; not a replacement for full runbooks.

Quickscore methodology (1-10 scale):
- 1-3: negligible or isolated impact, standard rollback available
- 4-6: noticeable customer-facing changes, requires coordination across 1-2 teams
- 7-10: high risk or widespread latency/cost/regulatory impact; exec notice and immediate mitigation plan needed

Table: (columns = ID | Area | ImpactScore | Owner | Blockers | EstMitigation | Priority | ShortNotes)
ID | Area | ImpactScore | Owner | Blockers | EstMitigation | Priority | ShortNotes
DQS-01 | Model routing policy change (multi-variant fallback) | 8 | Liam Chen | Canary config not validated for EU region; missing certs | 6h | P0 | If fallback misroutes to high-cost variant, token costs spike. Rollback plan ready but needs EU infra test. See PR#3124
DQS-02 | KV cache purge for prefix migration | 5 | Sofia Alvarez | Migration job may time out under heavy traffic | 3h | P1 | Throttle migration with traffic window. Expect minor latency for warmups.
DQS-03 | Billing meter update (billing SKU mapping) | 6 | Marcus Lee | Edge-case for embeddings batch size mapping not covered | 4h | P1 | Could mis-bill a small set of enterprise customers. Notify CS to hold invoices for two days. Jira JIRA-7782
DQS-04 | Private deployment onboarding workflow tweak | 4 | Priya Menon | Docs update lagging, onboarding script missing env var check | 2h | P2 | Low customer outage risk, higher SRE touch during first 24h.
DQS-05 | Dedicated autoscaler policy change (burst cap) | 7 | DevOps Team | Load test metrics ambiguous; autoscaler sim failing in staging | 8h | P0 | Risk of underprovisioning under sudden burst; start conservative rollout to subset of pools. Confluence: CONFLUENCE-DEPLOY-2026-08
DQS-06 | Console dashboard retention policy change | 3 | Analytics | Migration has long tail for historical SLI charts | 1h | P3 | Visual noise only; customers unaffected.

Row-level quick comments: 
- DQS-01: Need EU certs from infra; put a guard in routing config to avoid variant mismatch (Liam).
- DQS-02: Schedule migration during low-traffic window (weekday 02:00 PST). Sofia to prepare runbook snippet.
- DQS-03: Draft email to affected customers made; hold invoices until mapping validated (Marcus).
- DQS-05: Recommend canary at 10% of fleet, with automatic rollback on 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.

Aggregated status (automated quick tally):
- High (7-10): 2 items (DQS-01, DQS-05)
- Medium (4-6): 3 items (DQS-02, DQS-03, DQS-04)
- Low (1-3): 1 item (DQS-06)

Immediate action list (owner):
- Liam: Provision EU certs and run routing smoke test by EOD 2026-08-13. (blocked -> infra ticket CREATED: JIRA-7801)
- DevOps: Prepare conservative autoscaler canary plan and load-test notes; emergency rollback script review.
- Sofia: Finalize migration throttle parameters and add timeout safeguards.
- Marcus: Run billing mapping verification against sample accounts and hold invoice queue for affected SKUs.
- Priya: Update onboarding doc with env var check and notify partner onboarding team.

Open questions for triage meeting:
- Is there appetite to delay autoscaler policy until next week if load tests stay flaky? (impact vs runway tradeoff)
- Can we compress EU cert issuance to same-day if we escalate to infra on-call?

Notes-to-self / loose ideas: 
- Consider adding a lightweight webhook that pings CS when billing SKU changes affect >5 customers.
- Might add a 'confidence' column next pass to capture how much the owner trusts the estimate.

Version history (log):
- 2026-08-12 created by Priya (initial pass)
- 2026-08-13 entries updated after dev sync; added DQS-05 details (DevOps)
- 2026-08-18 reviewers added (Liam, Sofia, Marcus), minor edits and action owners assigned

Slack refs:
- #deploy-coord thread ts: 2026-08-12 10:22 (link: slack://channel/deploy-coord/thread/16234)
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3124

Intended next steps:
- Use this sheet as the single source for the brief 15-minute deploy readiness stand for Aug 19 deployment window.
- After deploy, capture postmortem items directly into CONFLUENCE-DEPLOY-2026-08 and mark rows closed with final notes.

End of sheet.
